settings.text: Picked by hand, not by algorithm

settings.heading: Sizing
settings.content:
Most bucket hats are a 56–58cm one-size fit. Where several sizes are listed, measure around your head just above the ears and go by that number.

Clothing runs to the size chart on the product images — if you're between sizes, go up.

settings.heading: Looking after it
settings.content: Anything cotton takes a cold wash, inside out, hung to dry rather than tumbled. Prints prefer to stay out of direct sunlight. Don't iron directly over a print.

settings.heading: Shipping & returns
settings.content:
Packed and posted as quickly as I can manage. Free UK shipping over £35; international is calculated at checkout.

Returns within 30 days, unworn and in original packaging. Message me and I'll sort it.
